V: Cold stone, and a great deal of it. The room just keeps going.
F: The kitchen hearth. The fire gives off no heat at all, and somehow still cooks.
4: A ghost stove, cooking ghost food. It smells the way soup used to.
x: A barrel stencilled SPECTRAL SPUDS. It's empty. Or it's full of something you can't see.
3: A table so long it has its own weather.
Every place is set. Every bowl holds something see-through and gently steaming.

objects.name: Cook Gristle
lines: Soup's on! Well. Soup's through. It goes straight through the bowl.
Five hundred years I've been cooking for this lot. Nobody's ever finished a plate.
How are we supposed to eat this? Don't ask me. I just cook it.

objects.name: Cook Wisp
lines: Careful, it's hot. Well. It was hot. Everything down here was something, once.
Have a roll. Go on. ...This is going to go right through me, isn't it.
Try the boo-berry pie. It's to die for.
...Too soon? It's been five hundred years. It's never too soon.

objects.name: Corporal Hobb
lines: Oh, hello! Welcome to the mess. Pull up a bench.
What is the point of having a table this long? Honestly. You can't pass the salt. Nobody's passed the salt in five hundred years.
Go on, walk down to the other end. Have a look. I'll wait.

objects.name: Corporal Hobb
lines: I'm the same ghost from earlier.
